CC=/pool/wrf-experiment/toolchains/gnu/13.3.0/bin/gcc
CFLAGS=-O2  -std=c11 -Wall -DNDEBUG -DHAVE_SYMVER -D_LARGEFILE64_SOURCE=1 -DHAVE_CPUID_GNU -DHAVE_SYS_AUXV_H -DHAVE_LINUX_AUXVEC_H -DZLIB_COMPAT -DWITH_GZFILEOP -DHAVE_VISIBILITY_HIDDEN -DHAVE_VISIBILITY_INTERNAL -DHAVE_ATTRIBUTE_ALIGNED -DHAVE_BUILTIN_ASSUME_ALIGNED -DHAVE_BUILTIN_CTZ -DHAVE_BUILTIN_CTZLL -DWITH_ALL_FALLBACKS -DWITH_OPTIM -DX86_FEATURES -DX86_HAVE_XSAVE_INTRIN -DX86_SSE2 -DX86_SSSE3 -DX86_SSE41 -DX86_SSE42 -DX86_PCLMULQDQ_CRC -DX86_AVX2 -DX86_AVX512 -DX86_AVX512VNNI -DX86_VPCLMULQDQ_CRC
SFLAGS=-O2  -std=c11 -Wall -fPIC -DNDEBUG -DHAVE_SYMVER -D_LARGEFILE64_SOURCE=1 -DHAVE_CPUID_GNU -DHAVE_SYS_AUXV_H -DHAVE_LINUX_AUXVEC_H -DZLIB_COMPAT -DWITH_GZFILEOP -fno-semantic-interposition -DHAVE_VISIBILITY_HIDDEN -DHAVE_VISIBILITY_INTERNAL -DHAVE_ATTRIBUTE_ALIGNED -DHAVE_BUILTIN_ASSUME_ALIGNED -DHAVE_BUILTIN_CTZ -DHAVE_BUILTIN_CTZLL -DWITH_ALL_FALLBACKS -DWITH_OPTIM -DX86_FEATURES -DX86_HAVE_XSAVE_INTRIN -DX86_SSE2 -DX86_SSSE3 -DX86_SSE41 -DX86_SSE42 -DX86_PCLMULQDQ_CRC -DX86_AVX2 -DX86_AVX512 -DX86_AVX512VNNI -DX86_VPCLMULQDQ_CRC
INCLUDES=-I/pool/wrf-experiment/builds/cpu-investigation/zlib-ng/build -I/pool/wrf-experiment/builds/cpu-investigation/zlib-ng/source
SUFFIX=

AVX512FLAG=-mavx512f -mavx512dq -mavx512bw -mavx512vl -mbmi2 -mtune=cascadelake
AVX512VNNIFLAG=-mavx512f -mavx512dq -mavx512bw -mavx512vl -mbmi2 -mavx512vnni -mtune=cascadelake
AVX2FLAG=-mavx2 -mbmi2
SSE2FLAG=-msse2
SSSE3FLAG=-mssse3
SSE41FLAG=-msse4.1
SSE42FLAG=-msse4.2
PCLMULFLAG=-mpclmul
VPCLMULFLAG=-mvpclmulqdq -mavx512f
XSAVEFLAG=-mxsave
NOLTOFLAG=-fno-lto

SRCDIR=/pool/wrf-experiment/builds/cpu-investigation/zlib-ng/source/arch/x86
SRCTOP=/pool/wrf-experiment/builds/cpu-investigation/zlib-ng/source
TOPDIR=$(SRCTOP)

all: \
	x86_features.o x86_features.lo \
	adler32_avx2.o adler32_avx2.lo \
	adler32_avx512.o adler32_avx512.lo \
	adler32_avx512_vnni.o adler32_avx512_vnni.lo \
